steps.say: A fraction is part of a whole. The whole is cut into equal parts.

figure.alt: A circle cut into 4 equal parts with 1 part shaded.

steps.say: 1 part out of 4 equal parts is one quarter.
The bottom number tells how many equal parts. The top number tells how many we take.
This bar has 5 equal parts and 3 are shaded.

figure.alt: A bar cut into 5 equal parts with 3 parts shaded.

options.why: The number of equal parts goes on the bottom.
Count all the parts, shaded and white. There are 8.

hints: Shaded parts go on top. All the parts go on the bottom.
check.explanation: 3 out of 8 equal parts are shaded, so 3/8 is shaded.

figure.alt: A bar cut into 8 equal parts with 3 parts shaded.

check.prompt: A cake is cut into 5 equal pieces. 2 pieces are eaten. How many fifths are left?
hints: Each piece is one fifth of the cake.
Take away the pieces that are eaten.
check.explanation: 5 - 2 = 3 pieces are left. That is 3/5 of the cake.
